subject: Mathematics
sourceFile: Copy of Mathematics BECE Syllabus - syllabusNG (1).txt
examFormat: The syllabus aims to make candidates recall mathematical formulas and concepts as a foundation for their next class and apply the concepts to real-life situations. The BECE Mathematics examination has three compulsory papers. Papers 1 and 2 consist of sixty multiple-choice questions each: Paper 1 covers Number and Numeration, Basic Operations, and Geometry and Measurement; Paper 2 covers Algebraic Processes and Everyday Statistics. Paper 3 comprises two compulsory questions set from any of the topics in the syllabus. The three papers make up 70% of the score and continuous assessment the remaining 30%; candidates bring a non-programmable calculator and the NECO Mathematical/Statistical Table.
excluded: Syllabus.ng marketing ("About us", "About BECE"), eligibility, registration, grading table, table of contents and the FAQ chapter were left out. The file lists no recommended textbooks. "Basic properties of cubes and cuboid", listed under both Similar Shapes and Three Dimensional Figures, is kept only under Three-Dimensional Figures.
